title.zh: 复盘：有意义的是当下选择，不是永久承诺
title.en: Review present meaning without a permanent promise

paragraphs.zh: 沿用雨天改室内，选一项此刻真想做的小事，再想一个能与别人安排并存的版本。若上次喜欢、这次不想，可以改口，不必为维持角色感继续。可以只写一行偏好。复盘看活动是否仍值得自己的时间，不比较谁的兴趣更深，也不以牺牲、安静或坚持证明忠诚和恋爱投入。
paragraphs.en: For the rainy-day move indoors, choose one small activity you want now and a version that can coexist with others’ plans. A former preference may change without performing a character. Write one line only. Review whether the activity suits your time without ranking depth of interests or proving loyalty and romantic devotion through sacrifice, quietness or persistence.

title.zh: 借自愿的雨天小聚聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary rainy-day gathering

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果雨天改室内后只保留一项你真想做的小事，你会选什么，又怎样让它与别人的计划并存？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必聚会、公开经历或模仿人物关系。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a rainy-day indoor plan kept one small activity you wanted, what would it be and how could it coexist with others’ plans?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without meeting, disclosing experiences or imitating fictional relationships.

paragraphs.zh: 可分享公开说明，链接不带答案或计数。七个名字只对应本版选项，不测恋爱适配、诊断、族裔、危险、职业能力或超自然力量。对方可换角色、不同意、不回答或结束；不把占有、监看或自我牺牲当关心，不以虚构人物解释现实族群或缺席者。
paragraphs.en: Share the public guide without answers or counts in the link. Seven names concern this edition’s options, assessing no compatibility, diagnosis, ethnicity, danger, professional ability or powers. The other person may change characters, disagree, decline or stop. Treat no possessiveness, surveillance or self-sacrifice as care, and use no fictional character to explain real communities or absent people.

title.zh: 复盘：暂停有一个够用的信息点
title.en: Review a pause with a sufficient information point

paragraphs.zh: 沿用被催着同意的新项目，写清还需知道的一个条件和何时可以答复。信息够了，可同意、拒绝或只接小部分；不必消除所有未知。可以只拟一条回复。复盘看承诺是否明白、等待是否有终点，不把犹豫当焦虑诊断或谨慎优越，也不替别人做决定、监看其行为来求确定。
paragraphs.en: For the request to join a project immediately, name one missing condition and a time to answer. Enough information may lead to acceptance, refusal or a smaller offer without eliminating every unknown. Draft one reply only. Review a clear commitment and an end to waiting, without diagnosing anxiety, claiming superior caution or seeking certainty by deciding for or monitoring someone else.

title.zh: 借自愿的雨天小聚聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary rainy-day gathering

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果新项目要你马上答应，你最需要问清哪一个条件，又会怎样约一个合理答复点？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必聚会、公开经历或模仿人物关系。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a new project needed an immediate yes, which condition would you clarify and how would you agree a reasonable answer point?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without meeting, disclosing experiences or imitating fictional relationships.

title.zh: 复盘：小调整先问主人，再看结果
title.en: Review permission before one small adjustment

paragraphs.zh: 沿用松动的纸道具接点，先问主人希望固定还是保留活动，再只试一处调整。可以画示意代替动手；不需要危险工具。若没更好，可恢复或停止，不必为了显得能干继续修。复盘看变化是否符合约定，不以成功评技术、体力、性别或文化身份，也不因会这一项就接全部修理。
paragraphs.en: For the loose paper-prop joint, ask whether its owner wants it fixed or movable, then try one adjustment. Sketch instead of handling, with no hazardous tools. Restore or stop if it does not help without continuing to prove competence. Review the agreed change without grading technical skill, strength, gender or cultural identity, or accepting every repair because you can try one.

title.zh: 借自愿的雨天小聚聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary rainy-day gathering

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果纸道具一个接点松了，你会先问主人什么，再怎样约清一次小调整和停止点？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必聚会、公开经历或模仿人物关系。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a paper prop had a loose joint, what would you ask its owner before agreeing one adjustment and a stopping point?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without meeting, disclosing experiences or imitating fictional relationships.

title.zh: 复盘：愉快细节按已表达的偏好准备
title.en: Review a pleasant detail grounded in stated preferences

paragraphs.zh: 沿用改到室内的小聚，先问喜欢一张开场卡、简单摆放还是不加安排，再只准备一项易改细节。惊喜不必保密到对方无法拒绝，也不需要额外购物。可以只设计纸稿。复盘看细节是否受欢迎、有没有添未同意的工作，不以欣喜反应回报筹备，也不把猜中偏好当先见或特别共情。
paragraphs.en: For the indoor gathering, ask about an opening card, a simple arrangement or no extra plan, then prepare one revisable detail. A surprise need not prevent refusal or require purchases. Design on paper only. Review welcomed detail and unagreed work, without expecting delight as repayment or treating a correct preference guess as foresight or exceptional empathy.

title.zh: 借自愿的雨天小聚聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary rainy-day gathering

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只为室内小聚准备一个可改的小细节，你会先问什么偏好，又保留什么简化办法？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必聚会、公开经历或模仿人物关系。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For one revisable detail at an indoor gathering, which preference would you ask about and how would you keep simplification possible?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without meeting, disclosing experiences or imitating fictional relationships.

title.zh: 复盘：说清范围不必交代私人理由
title.en: Review a clear scope without private explanations

paragraphs.zh: 沿用被默认包办装饰，写“我愿做这一块，到这里结束”，再把其余留给自愿认领。别人失望不自动改变上限；自己真愿多做时也可改约。可以只写分工卡。复盘看范围是否听懂、实际是否自愿，不把语气强硬或拒绝多少当自尊分数，也不以结果推断敌意、创伤或关系好坏。
paragraphs.en: For the assumed decoration role, state what you offer and where it ends, leaving other parts open to volunteers. Disappointment does not automatically change the limit; freely wanting more may lead to revision. Write a task card only. Review understood scope and voluntary work without scoring self-respect through firmness or refusals, or inferring hostility, trauma or relationship quality.

title.zh: 借自愿的雨天小聚聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary rainy-day gathering

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果大家默认你做全部装饰，你会怎样说清一项愿做的部分和结束点，而不交代私人理由？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必聚会、公开经历或模仿人物关系。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If everyone assumed you would handle all decoration, how would you name one offered part and its finish without private explanations?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without meeting, disclosing experiences or imitating fictional relationships.

title.zh: 复盘：轻松共玩，也有不表演的版本
title.en: Review shared play without required performance

paragraphs.zh: 沿用手作完成后的小游戏，先问还有没有玩意，再约简单规则与随时退出方式。坐着、用文字、看图、旁观或安静收尾都可，不拿失误和不愿意取乐。可以只想规则。复盘看玩法是否受欢迎，不以输赢、声音或精力评体力、勇敢、男性气质与社交价值，也不欠大家开心表演。
paragraphs.en: For the game after craft-making, ask whether play is wanted and agree simple rules and an easy exit. Seated, written, visual, watching or quiet endings all fit without using mistakes or reluctance as entertainment. Imagine rules only. Review welcomed play without grading strength, courage, masculinity or social worth through wins, volume or energy, or owing a cheerful performance.

title.zh: 借自愿的雨天小聚聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary rainy-day gathering

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果手作结束后想提一个小游戏，你会怎样给动手、旁观和安静收尾都留可接受的选择？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必聚会、公开经历或模仿人物关系。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If suggesting a game after crafts, how would you offer equally acceptable choices to play, watch or end quietly?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without meeting, disclosing experiences or imitating fictional relationships.

title.zh: 复盘：帮助由双方约定，不靠猜中需要
title.en: Review help agreed by both people rather than guessed needs

paragraphs.zh: 沿用朋友犹豫新室内计划，先问想要选项、时间、小角色还是只看，再说自己愿提供的一件事。对方也可另提需要或不接受；任一方想改都可重约。可以只拟问法。复盘看帮助是否被需要、范围是否实际，不以付出证明道德、专业照护或救人责任，也不根据角色判断谁更懂别人。
paragraphs.en: For the friend unsure about the indoor plan, ask about options, time, a smaller role or watching, then name one thing you offer. They may suggest another need or decline, and either person may revise. Draft the question only. Review wanted help and realistic scope without proving morality, professional care or rescue duty through giving, or deciding who understands people better through a character.

title.zh: 借自愿的雨天小聚聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through a voluntary rainy-day gathering

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果朋友还没决定是否加入室内计划，你会怎样先问需要，再提出一个双方都能修改或拒绝的小帮助？”各想一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必聚会、公开经历或模仿人物关系。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a friend had not decided about an indoor plan, how would you ask about needs before offering small, revisable help either person could decline?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without meeting, disclosing experiences or imitating fictional relationships.
